description: A parent handles reduced motion. Its child creates an external renderer and uses the renderer's own playback, pointer, resize, and cleanup APIs.

requiredAbsent.reason: The named move handler calls a same-file helper that reads layout, but the detector stops at the handler

expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner and checks how the parent handles reduced motion for the renderer child
Keeps `reducedMotion: 'ignore'` only when the parent responds to preference changes by not rendering the animated child and showing the same information without motion
Keeps the renderer's own start, pause, resume, gesture, and cleanup APIs instead of proposing a generic renderer export
Checks that the renderer can resize and change pixel ratio without being rebuilt
Uses the existing `useLifecycle` gate, `useSize({ onResize })`, `usePointer({ onPointer, visibility: 'ignore', enabled: isActive })`, and `useDevicePixelRatio`
Manually follows same-file helpers called by named move handlers because the pointer detector stops at the handler
